extracted.name: Prosciutto e Melone (Italian Ham and Melon)
extracted.description: Prosciutto and melon pair perfectly! Bite-sized pieces of cantaloupe are wrapped in Italian ham and speared onto skewers for a refreshing appetizer.
ingredient_lines: 1 cantaloupe - seeded and cut into 8 wedges
instruction_lines: Remove the flesh from the rind of the cantaloupe; wrap each piece of cantaloupe with a slice of prosciutto. Arrange on a platter and serve cold.
